The course is 3 hours, costs $85, and includes live skills practice and certification support. 8-Hour Infection Control Course $395 Next: August 1, 2026 Board-approved 8-hour Infection Control training for unlicensed dental assistants. Current BLS through AHA or ARC plus a 2-hour Dental Practice Act certification are required. Radiation Safety Course $695 Next: September 5, 2026 32-hour Radiation Safety training for dental personnel and dentists who want staff x-ray certified. Students need current BLS, Infection Control, Dental Practice Act, and must not be pregnant. Coronal Polish Course $500 Next: September 12, 2026 12-hour Coronal Polish training for eligible dental assistants, with didactic, lab, manikin, written exam, and human patient clinical requirements. Pit and Fissure Sealant Course $550 Next: September 12, 2026 16-hour Pit and Fissure Sealant training for eligible dental assistants and RDAs. Completion does not allow students to perform sealants until they are licensed. OFFERED COURSES Dental Assisting Training Course - $2,500.00 Our dental assisting program is designed to be completed in just 9 weeks. The program prepares students for an entry-level position in a dental office. All lectures and hands on learning will be done in our office at Waikiki Dental. We keep class sizes small for a better teacher to student focus. Our goal is to set students up for success by teaching you exactly what the staff at the dental office will expect you to know. Our accelerated program totals 9 weeks (210 hours) of combined class, clinical, and homework. Classes generally meet on either Mondays or Friday with one day of assigned externship. Dental Assisting is a 9-week, 210-hour training course for students age 16 and older, with online lectures, homework, chairside experience, resume and job assistance, and a 64-hour internship component. Next available start: September 12, 2026. Additional starts are October 12 and November 20, 2026. LEARN MORE N95 Fit Test - $89.99 (By Appointment Only) Qualitative test for N-95 Masks. This will help bring you in compliance with OSHA regulations. We can perform the initial fit test as well as the annual fit test. We will use the TSI Portacount machine to fit test one N95 mask, Each additional mask is $20. You must provide the mask you wish to be test on. Due to the way the test is done the mask will not be able to be used after the test is complete. A report will be generated and emailed to you detailing the results of the fit test. For best results please do not have facial hair or wear makeup. BOOK APPOINTMENT HERE One-on-one Implant and Bone Grafting Coaching Learn to place dental implant using both CBCT guided as well as free hand techniques. Bone grafting and crestal approach sinus augmentation using various techniques including PRF. This is a custom tailored course, directly with Dr. Michael Narodovich, hands on with your own patients. This is ideal for dentists who have taken courses but do not feel comfortable grafting and placing implant on their own. This course is 100% customizable to your needs and learning style. BOOK APPOINTMENT HERE COURSES FOR HYGIENIST ERGONOMICS AND PATIENT CARE A skills-based refresher for dental hygienists covering periodontal review, clinical ergonomics, and scaling techniques—now expanded to include dental emergencies, common medications and their implications for periodontal health, patient communication, and referral decision-making. Participants will reinforce periodontal fundamentals and risk assessment, improve operator/patient positioning to reduce musculoskeletal strain, and refine instrumentation. WHY DENTAL ASSISTING? Employment Outlook Dental Assistants jobs are expected to increase by 15.3% between 2018 and 2028. Median Wage Starting pay is between $18 - $22 depending on your state and employer. Flexible Schedules Dental assisting gives you an opportunity to have a work/life balance. Full time, part time, and temping positions allows for a flexible work schedule. Not to mention most offices have evenings, weekends, and holidays off. Multiple Career Paths Being a Dental Assistant is the stepping stone into the dental field. You will explore a variety of career options the dental field has to offer. As a dental assistant you will have the knowledge to make an easy transition to another role in dentistry.
